purpose: Prevent duplicate prerequisite validation and immutable operator execution while the exact-reviewed bounded activation candidate moves across chats, reviews, or operator sessions.

active_base.title: Final M3-C-H exact validation evidence pin

non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
reporting-only reuse of the pinned prerequisite chain
invalidators: a new M3-C-I code or authorization tree requiring its own validation
artifact loss, corruption, expiry without retained immutable copy, or SHA-256 mismatch
validation workflow, pinned dependency, focused scope, or forward-registration change
new_tree_rule: The M3-C-I tree receives one new exact validation only for its actual changed tree. PR 225 validation remains a reused immutable implementation prerequisite and must not be rerun.
discovery_rule: Compile, focused tests, M0 invariance, and M2-B may run on discovery. Full-suite must remain blocked until every exact forward fingerprint is registered, then run exactly once on the final registered head.
next_chat_rule: Inspect this pin, M3_C_H_PREREQUISITE_VALIDATION_REUSE_PIN.json, and EXACT_HEAD_VALIDATION_REUSE_LEDGER.json before scheduling tests or operator commands. Reuse PR 225 evidence; validate only the actual M3-C-I tree; do not rerun phone evidence or retained sequences.
